raw.query: WITH current_dim AS (SELECT run_id, is_current, superseded_by, tp, n_replicas FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = TRUE), belief AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS ticks_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT b.is_degenerate) AS ticks_non_degenerate, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.engine_rps) FILTER (WHERE NOT b.is_degenerate) AS median_engine_rps FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.capacity_belief_sample b USING (run_id) WHERE d.run_id = 'riders:fc_lead60' AND d.superseded_by IS NULL), sla AS (SELECT MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'ttft' AND bound_stat = 'p99') AS ttft_bound_ms, MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'itl' AND bound_stat = 'p99') AS itl_bound_ms FROM provenance.v_sla_bound), probe_latency AS (SELECT c.run_id, c.window_name, c.probe_kind, c.arrival_speedup, c.forecast_req_scale, c.offered_rps_per_replica, c.implied_r_tail, c.tp, c.n_replicas, d.is_current AS dim_is_current, d.superseded_by, c.is_superseded AS config_is_superseded, BOOL_AND(p.is_current) AS latency_is_current, MIN(p.n_requests) AS n_requests, MAX(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE p.sla_metric = 'ttft') AS p99_ttft_ms, MAX(p.p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE p.sla_metric = 'itl') AS p99_itl_ms FROM current_dim d JOIN provenance.v_riders_probe_config c USING (run_id) JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p USING (run_id) WHERE d.superseded_by IS NULL AND c.is_superseded = FALSE AND p.is_current = TRUE AND ((c.window_name = 'burst1' AND c.probe_kind = 'arrival_speedup') OR (c.window_name = 'burst4' AND c.probe_kind = 'forecast_scale')) GROUP BY c.run_id, c.window_name, c.probe_kind, c.arrival_speedup, c.forecast_req_scale, c.offered_rps_per_replica, c.implied_r_tail, c.tp, c.n_replicas, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, c.is_superseded) SELECT b.ticks_total, b.ticks_non_degenerate, b.median_engine_rps AS r_hat_median_rps, q.run_id, q.window_name, q.probe_kind, q.arrival_speedup, q.forecast_req_scale, q.offered_rps_per_replica, q.implied_r_tail, CASE WHEN q.forecast_req_scale IS NOT NULL THEN q.forecast_req_scale * q.implied_r_tail END AS implied_r_hat_rps, q.tp, q.n_replicas, q.n_requests, q.p99_ttft_ms, s.ttft_bound_ms, q.p99_itl_ms, s.itl_bound_ms, (q.p99_ttft_ms <= s.ttft_bound_ms AND q.p99_itl_ms <= s.itl_bound_ms) AS passes_tail_sla, (q.dim_is_current AND q.superseded_by IS NULL AND NOT q.config_is_superseded AND q.latency_is_current) AS is_effective FROM probe_latency q CROSS JOIN belief b CROSS JOIN sla s ORDER BY q.window_name, COALESCE(q.offered_rps_per_replica, q.implied_r_tail)
raw.observed: All rows are effective/current and unsuperseded. r_hat median=10.07 over 86 non-degenerate ticks (89 total). Under p99 TTFT/ITL bounds 1000/100 ms, burst1 N=2 TP2 (n=64804) passes at offered 1.6233047244 req/s/replica (905.859/25.317 ms) and fails at 2.1643370640 (1078.610/112.979 ms). Burst4 N=2 TP2 (n=25639) has offered_rps_per_replica=NULL: its forecast-scale implied values 1.25875 and 1.4385714286 pass, while 1.6189710611 fails (TTFT p99 1103.912 ms).
raw.evidence: The 10.07 median and burst1 largest-tested pass are supported, but burst4's 1.26–1.44 values are implied forecast-scale assumptions—not measured offered rates—and the pass/fail boundary is between 1.4386 and 1.6190, so calling [1.26,1.44] the measured tail knee overclaims the evidence.
